expected.reason: Line 545: `for folderName in ["overrides", "server-overrides"]` -- a fixed array literal order, overrides/ first, server-overrides/ second. Since mergeDirectory unconditionally overwrites the destination for every file it copies (line 856: `try? fm.removeItem(at: dest)` before the copy), a file present in BOTH trees at the same relative path ends up with server-overrides/'s content, because it's copied last.
